Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it «Ikona Sv. Save u manastiru Krupa» and files it under “Icons of Saint Sava” and “Krupa monastery” — an icon of St Sava in the Serbian monastery of Krupa. Sava of Serbia, the first archbishop of the Serbs, not Sabbas the Sanctified, whose Commons icons are filed separately. Commons describes it: Ikona Sv. Save u manastiru Krupa.
